title: Underground 10
method: Afri Index's listening order for this edition: distinctive sound, a clear entry-point song and documented activity in the underground scene. Positions are editorial choices, not a popularity chart or measured streaming score. Paid placements never affect this order. Artists on the Current 50 are excluded. Broader African coverage will be added as sources are verified.

artists.name: scottyolorin
artists.note: Start with the hook on this collaboration with DaveTheOracle and Kobilou.

artists.name: Monochrome
artists.note: Abuja's collaborative scene makes a compelling starting point for this artist.

artists.name: Egertton
artists.note: A forceful entry point into his self-described incantation music.

artists.name: Kobilou
artists.note: Begin with this song, then explore his Pretty Girls Love Lou project.

artists.name: Luwa.Mp4
artists.note: The JELEEL! collaboration opens a door into his punk-influenced sound.

artists.name: Indi
artists.note: A vocal-led discovery for listeners exploring the scene's hyperpop side.

artists.name: onoola-sama
artists.note: Try this DEELA collaboration from the fujiBouyon* EP.

artists.name: BLNDE
artists.note: An accessible first listen before the BLNDE 4 PRESIDENT project.

artists.name: Danpapa GTA
artists.note: A lively entry point from a producer who also records.

artists.name: SSSoundGawd
artists.note: His Mavo collaboration is a useful introduction to the rapper-producer.
